files.purpose: WallpaperStore is the app-wide @MainActor @Observable model owning the window's optional backdrop picture: it accepts a user-picked image file, copies it into the app's wallpaper library directory under a generated UUID name, decodes and downsamples it off the main thread, softens it by a persisted 0...1 softness value using a Gaussian blur, and republishes the rendered NSImage for RootView's WindowBackdrop and the Appearance settings card's WallpaperCard row to read. It also drives a separate fast 'live' render path from a half-size preview copy while the softness slider is actively dragged, so the slider stays responsive, and falls back to a full-size render once the drag ends.

ui_elements: None declared directly in this file - it is a headless @Observable store, not a SwiftUI View. It feeds two UI surfaces declared elsewhere: the Appearance settings card's wallpaper row (isInstalling spinner, lastError text "That is not a picture." / "Could not use that picture.") and RootView's WindowBackdrop (image).

Two named animation curves a consumer visibly experiences: .easeOut(duration: 0.25) when the wallpaper is removed, .spring(duration: 0.45, bounce: 0.2) when a new one finishes installing; no animation on an ordinary softness re-render (documented in-line as deliberate, to avoid a flash).

Every changed line is a pure identifier rename with no behavior difference: line 75 `WebsiteCaptures.defaults` -> `CaptureRun.defaults`; line 89 `Storage.wallpaperDirectory` -> `StoragePaths.wallpaperDirectory`; line 128 same rename inside the generated destination path; line 130 same rename in the createDirectory(at:) call. This matches upstream commit d70cff8fe 'refactor: audit cleanups - five bug fixes, shared MCP and provider code, layer rules restored', which is a housekeeping rename pass, not a feature change.

The renamed types themselves (CaptureRun and StoragePaths) are declared in DroppyCode/Core/Support/CaptureRun.swift and DroppyCode/Services/Store/Storage.swift respectively - separate B3-tracked files outside this bundle's scope; this bundle only records that Wallpaper.swift's call sites now name the new identifiers with identical runtime meaning (same shared UserDefaults suite, same wallpaper directory).
